lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 5 -- What Happened Yesterday

listenings.text: Right, end of shift report. We had three rescues today. The first one was at seven in the morning, a swimmer near the rocks, and that one was easy. The second one was two surfers with one board between them, and honestly that was their own fault. The third one was at eleven. A rip took a young boy past the flags. He didn't panic, he waved, and we reached him in two minutes. Good kid. Nobody went to hospital today and after lunch everybody swam between the flags, so I call that a good day.

You will not believe my morning. I was paddling back out and I saw a boy in the rip with no board. So I turned around and I went straight to him. He was fine, actually. He didn't panic at all. He stopped fighting the current and he swam sideways, exactly like you are supposed to. We came in together and he just laughed. Then he asked me about the sandbank, so I lent him my old board and he went straight back out. Fifteen years old, maybe. Legend.
